name: Fang Needle
description: Loose a needle of hard venom qi from between two fingers like a fang.

name: Fang Cover
description: Cross both forearms in a cover of fang-shaped venom that bites the hand that strikes it.

name: Fang Scent
description: Scent the sweet and sour traces that fresh venom leaves on cloth and skin.

name: Fang Lunge
description: Lunge forward in a long low line and end with both fangs at the foe's ribs.

name: Fang Hook
description: Hook a fang of venom into the sleeve or arm and drag the foe off balance.

name: Fang Spray
description: Spit a spray of small fangs of venom across the foe's face and chest.

name: Fang Rend
description: Drive both fangs into the guard arm and rend it open with a twist of the wrists.

name: Fang Sweep
description: Sweep both arms out in a low arc and loose a line of fangs at every foe.

name: Fang Streak
description: Cross the field in one streak of venom qi and strike from the foe's blind side.

name: Crowned Fangs
description: Crown the foe's neck with two fangs of venom that sink as one and freeze the limbs.

name: Cobalt Dart
description: Flick a dart of deep blue venom qi that streaks low and true.

name: Cobalt Skin
description: Dye the skin a deep blue with venom qi so that striking hands numb on contact.

name: Cobalt Taste
description: Taste the blue edge of a poison on the air and name its strength.

name: Cobalt Palm
description: Strike with a palm full of blue venom and press the poison deep into the muscle.

name: Cobalt Veil
description: Spread a deep blue veil of mist before the face that splits one target into two.

name: Cobalt Draught
description: Give an ally a draught of cool blue qi that clears the burn of a fresh poison.

name: Cobalt Pair
description: Lay two blue bands of venom on the foe's wrists so the hands pull together.

name: Cobalt Thrust
description: Thrust a long blue spike of venom through the guard in one straight stroke.

name: Cobalt Rain
description: Call down blue venom in fine drops over a wide patch of the field.

name: Cobalt Absolution
description: Draw every drop of venom that touches the user into the blood and leave the body clean.

name: Cobalt Judgement
description: Pass sentence on the foe with a blue venom that seals the channels and wastes the body.

name: Bloom Seed
description: Throw a seed of venom that opens into a small bloom against the target.

name: Bloom Petal
description: Open a single petal of venom qi that turns a thrust aside.

name: Bloom Perfume
description: Read the sweet perfume of a nearby bloom of toxin and trace where it grows.

name: Bloom Drift
description: Let a drift of bloom mist fall on the foes until their steps grow heavy.

name: Bloom Thorn
description: Push a thorn of venom from the heart of the bloom into the foe's side.

name: Bloom Canopy
description: Close the petals round the user and allies in a bloom no thrown weapon can enter.

name: Bloom Crossing
description: Cross the mists of two blooms over the foes so the toxin thickens where they meet.

name: Bloom Snare
description: Plant a hidden bloom that snaps shut on the first foot to press it.

name: Bloom Vanish
description: Dissolve into the petals of a bloom of mist and step out of another beside the foe.

name: Twin Bloom
description: Open two great blooms side by side so their mists cross and choke all in the field.

name: Miasma Bead
description: Flick a bead of miasma that bursts into a foul cloud around the target.

name: Miasma Cloak
description: Pull a cloak of foul air round the body that spoils the aim of those who strike.

name: Miasma Reading
description: Read the movement of foul air to learn where living bodies stand in it.

name: Miasma Pool
description: Let miasma settle in a still pool round the foes and drag at their legs.

name: Miasma Lance
description: Narrow the miasma into a lance and drive it through a gap in the guard.

name: Miasma Purge
description: Draw the miasma out of an ally's lungs and send it down into the earth.

name: Miasma Dive
description: Dive through the cloud like a hawk and strike with a core-fed venom stab.

name: Miasma Sink
description: Let the cloud sink and taint the ground so every foe that crosses it sickens.

name: Miasma Core
description: Draw the whole cloud into the core and send a pure point of venom through hide and ward.

name: Hawk Plague
description: Dive like a hawk and settle as a basin of plague over every foe in the field.

name: Vowed Dart
description: Loose a dart sworn to its mark that bends a hand's breadth to keep the oath.

name: Vowed Skin
description: Wear a skin of venom that keeps its vow to stand until the blow has passed.

name: Vowed Scent
description: Follow the scent of a sworn poison across the wind to its maker.

name: Vowed Step
description: Step on the line of the vow and arrive where the foe is about to be.

name: Vowed Lash
description: Lash a cord of sworn venom to the foe's ankle that holds to the end of the oath.

name: Vowed Prick
description: Prick the exact nerve the vow named, a thing no dodge can save.

name: Vowed Squall
description: Raise a wind sworn to the foes' direction that carries venom across all of them.

name: Vowed Fang
description: Strike with a fang that cannot be turned away once the oath has been spoken.

name: Vowed Slip
description: Flash along the line of the oath to the foe's side before the dart arrives.

name: Unturned Venom
description: Loose a sworn venom that cannot be turned and sinks in whatever stands in the way.

name: Dwindle Dose
description: Press a dwindling dose into the foe's palm that saps grip over many breaths.

name: Dwindle Guard
description: Dull the strength of a poison by counting its doses down inside the blood.

name: Dwindle Count
description: Count the doses left in a poisoned body by the slowing of its pulse.

name: Dwindle Hush
description: Hush a foe's breath with a dwindling dose that quiets the chest.

name: Stage Venom
description: Lay a dose that takes hold in stages, each worse than the last.

name: Stage Cure
description: Lift a staged poison from an ally one stage at a time until the blood is clear.

name: Stage Mist
description: Breathe a mist that slows its victims by one stage with each lungful.

name: Stage Spike
description: Sink a spike of venom that deepens its hold with every beat of the heart.

name: Long Wasting
description: Hold a wide haze of wasting qi over the foes that takes more strength each breath.

name: Lingering Verdict
description: Seal the foe's strength inside a slow poison that must be endured to its end.

name: Dwindle Absolve
description: Take the full course of a poison into the blood in one breath and spend it as strength.

name: Slow Death Oath
description: Swear the foe to the slow death and let the oath run its course through every guard.

name: Toxin Mark
description: Mark a foe with a faint toxin the user can follow across the whole field.

name: Toxin Veil
description: Hang a thin toxin veil before the chest that eats the point of arrows.

name: Toxin Flick
description: Flick a pellet of toxin toward the marked foe from many paces.

name: Toxin Homing
description: Loose a pellet that follows the mark the whole way and bends around cover.

name: Toxin Tether
description: Tether the marked foe to the user by a thread of toxin that pulls when they flee.

name: Toxin Glide
description: Glide along the toxin's thread toward the mark in a long low arc.

name: Toxin Barrage
description: Loose a spread of homing pellets that all find the mark from different sides.

name: Toxin Trace
description: Lace the foe's trail with a trace that sickens every pursuer or ally who follows it.

name: Thread Leap
description: Step through the thread to the other end of the tether in no time at all.

name: Marked Doom
description: Close every thread of toxin on the marked foe at once through hide, ward and guard.

name: Hemlock Bead
description: Roll a bead of hemlock qi toward the foe along an open line.

name: Hemlock Shroud
description: Cloak the body in hemlock qi that numbs any hand that grips it.

name: Hemlock Tongue
description: Taste the faint bitterness of hemlock in the air and name each source.

name: Hemlock Hush
description: Spread hemlock qi that hushes the nerves of all who breathe it.

name: Hemlock Cut
description: Cut across the foe's guard with hemlock qi that numbs the arm at once.

name: Hemlock Antidote
description: Give an ally the counter to hemlock through the breath and watch the numbness fade.

name: Hemlock Choke
description: Spread hemlock across the open field so every foe within it slows and chokes.

name: Hemlock Belt
description: Seal the field's edge with a belt of numbing qi that no foe can cross unslowed.

name: Hemlock Core
description: Press the core's full hemlock into one point and pass it through hide and ward.

name: Open Hemlock Sovereign
description: Declare the field open and fill it with core-fed hemlock that no one can hide from.
